results.author: MBIE fuel response data
results.name: weekly-fuel-stock-updates
results.notes:
This data reflects current stocks for petrol, diesel and jet fuel in New Zealand. It is collated by MBIE’s fuel response team as part of an ongoing assessment of New Zealand’s fuel security situation, following events in the Middle East from 2026.

This data was originally updated twice a week, but has since moved to a weekly update schedule from the week commencing 13 July 2026. From 29 October 2026, it is updated every Thursday.

More detail on New Zealand’s fuel stocks and fuel supply chain, including ships transporting fuel to New Zealand, are published on our Fuel stock and shipping updates page on the MBIE website: https://www.mbie.govt.nz/building-and-energy/energy-and-natural-resources/energy-generation-and-markets/liquid-fuel-market/fuel-supply-disruption-response/fuel-stock-and-shipping-updates

resources.name: Companies Entity Role Search

resources.description: Companies Disqualified Director Search is a REST API that provides the facility for searching for disqualified company directors or prohibited company managers by name. See the Companies Register website for more information about how and why directors may be prohibited. https://companies-register.companiesoffice.govt.nz/help-centre/company-directors/banned-directors/
resources.name: Companies-Disqualified Director Search

resources.description:
Public data sets for the Companies Office registers. Accessible by requesting access to our bulk data service and updated monthly.  

We currently offer the following Companies Office Bulk Data in CSV format:  

* Companies
    -  New Zealand limited companies
    - New Zealand unlimited companies
    - New Zealand co-operative companies
    - overseas ASIC companies
    - overseas non-ASIC companies
* Charitable trust boards
* Retirement villages
* Other incorporated entities
    - incorporated societies
    - New Zealand limited partnerships
    - overseas limited partnerships
* Public sector entities
    - central government
    - local government
    - education
    - other public entities
* Unincorporated entities
    - sole traders
    - partnerships
    - trusts
* Māori Business Identifier information (all entities)

We also offer Financial Service Providers Register (FSPR) Bulk Data in JSON format only.  

The Companies Office also publishes a file of general company statistics on a monthly basis, including the number of company incorporations, removals, liquidations, receiverships and voluntary administrations.  

More information is available at https://www.companiesoffice.govt.nz/insights-and-articles/latest-company-statistics/  

Terms discussed in the Bulk Data Access agreement:
https://www.companiesoffice.govt.nz/data-services/ways-to-get-our-data/bulk-data-access-agreement/
resources.name: Companies Office bulk data

resources.description:
The Personal Property Securities Register (PPSR) is a centralised, electronic register where details of security interests in personal property can be registered and searched. The PPSR API is a REST service which provides a real-time, secure, direct link between your business systems and the PPSR. You can conduct most PPSR transactions, including searches, registrations, renewals, amendments and discharges, directly from your own software, instead of using the PPSR website.
Some PPSR transactions require official fees to be paid per the schedule on the PPSR website.
https://ppsr.companiesoffice.govt.nz/help-centre/paying-ppsr-fees/schedule-of-fees/
resources.name: Personal Property Securities Register (PPSR)

resources.description: The Disclose Public API is a SOAP service which provides a method for systems to search and retrieve full public details of schemes, offers, funds, and documents in a structured data format of offers of financial products and managed investment schemes from the Disclose Register.
resources.name: Disclose Public

resources.description: The Disclose Compliance API is a SOAP service with four operations for use by fund managers to create funds, identify compliance activities, submit compliance data, and verify that compliance activities have been completed on the Disclose Register.
resources.name: Disclose Compliance

resources.description: The Companies API is provided for users to reserve company names, incorporate new companies, and maintain companies on the New Zealand Companies Register that they have authority over. This API currently includes functions to enable the filing of an annual return and maintaining director, shareholding and general company details such as addresses. It can also be used to reserve a company name and incorporate a new company.
resources.name: Companies

results.name: insolvency-statistics
results.notes: The Insolvency and Trustee Service (ITS) is a business unit of the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment. ITS is also called the Official Assignee's Office. The Official Assignee is appointed under the State Sector Act 1988 to administer the Insolvency Act 2006, the insolvency provisions of the Companies Act 1993 and the Criminal Proceeds (Recovery) Act 2009. The Official Assignee administers all bankruptcies, No Asset Procedures, Summary Instalment Orders and some liquidations.
